question: Deal apa aja yg dibuat 7 hari terakhir? sertain nama customer & tim sales
pred:
SELECT 
    d.deal_id,
    d.customer_id,
    d.rep_id,
    d.title,
    d.stage,
    d.value,
    d.probability,
    d.products_involved,
    d.created_date,
    d.closed_date,
    d.updated_at,
    s.name AS sales_rep_name,
    t.name AS team_name
FROM 
    deals d
JOIN 
    sales_reps s ON d.rep_id = s.rep_id
JOIN 
    teams t ON s.team = t.team
WHERE 
    d.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
ORDER BY 
    d.created_date DESC
gold: SELECT d.title, c.name AS customer_name, r.team FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.created_date >= subtractDays(now(), 7)

question: Rekap jumlah aktivitas mingguan per tim dalam 60 hari terakhir dan perubahannya dibanding minggu sebelumnya.
pred:
SELECT 
    team,
    COUNT(activity_id) AS total_activities,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(timestamp) = DATE(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activities_last_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(timestamp) = DATE(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 2 MONTH)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activities_two_months_ago
FROM 
    activities
WHERE 
    DATE(timestamp) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 60 DAY)
GROUP BY 
    team
gold: SELECT r.team, toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, count() - lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY minggu) AS selisih_minggu_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 60) GROUP BY r.team, minggu ORDER BY r.team, minggu

question: Rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket per tier pelanggan berapa jam?
pred:
SELECT AVG(T2.resolution_time_hours) AS avg_resolution_time_hours
FROM support_tickets AS T1
JOIN deals AS T2 ON T1.ticket_id = T2.ticket_id
JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.customer_id = T3.customer_id
WHERE T3.tier IN ('Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze')
GROUP BY T3.tier
gold: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier ORDER BY rata_rata_jam

question: brp persen nilai pipeline yg datang dari customer yg udah churn?
pred:
SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(value) FROM deals WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE status = 'churned')) / 
    (SELECT SUM(value) FROM deals WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE status = 'active')) * 100 AS churned_pipeline_percentage
FROM 
    deals
WHERE 
    customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE status = 'churned')
gold: SELECT round(sumIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned')) / sum(d.value), 2) AS rasio_pipeline_churn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: Tampilkan aktivitas paling baru untuk setiap tipe aktivitas.
pred:
SELECT activity_id, customer_id, rep_id, type, duration_minutes, sentiment, timestamp
FROM activities
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT a.type, a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE (a.type, a.timestamp) IN (SELECT a.type, max(a.timestamp) FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type)

question: Berapa deal yang melibatkan Security-Plus di tiap stage?
pred: SELECT stage, COUNT(deal_id) FROM deals WHERE products_involved = 'Security-Plus' GROUP BY stage
gold: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus') GROUP BY d.stage

question: Sales mana yang rata-rata durasi aktivitasnya lebih lama dari rata-rata semua aktivitas?
pred:
SELECT rep_id, AVG(duration_minutes) AS avg_duration
FROM activities
GROUP BY rep_id
HAVING AVG(duration_minutes) > (
    SELECT AVG(duration_minutes) AS avg_duration
    FROM activities
)
ORDER BY avg_duration DESC
LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT a.rep_id, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id HAVING avg(a.duration_minutes) > (SELECT avg(a.duration_minutes) FROM activities AS a) ORDER BY rata_rata_durasi DESC

question: Bandingkan rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket antara pelanggan dengan omset di atas 1.000.000 dan pelanggan lainnya.
pred:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN t.closed_date - t.created_date ELSE NULL END) AS avg_resolution_time,
    CASE WHEN t.value > 1000000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS high_low
FROM 
    support_tickets t
GROUP BY 
    high_low
ORDER BY 
    avg_resolution_time
gold: SELECT round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) > 1000000)), 2) AS rata_rata_omset_besar, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) > 1000000)), 2) AS rata_rata_lainnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: Bandingkan jumlah pelanggan baru per segmen tahun ini dengan periode yang sama tahun lalu.
pred:
SELECT 
    segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'churned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'blacklisted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blacklisted_customers
FROM 
    customers
WHERE 
    created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
GROUP BY 
    segment
gold: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS baru_ytd, countIf(c.created_at < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS baru_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND (c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) OR c.created_at < subtractYears(now(), 1)) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Berapa persen pelanggan yang punya tag high-value di tiap segmen?
pred:
SELECT 
    segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tags LIKE '%high-value%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS high_value_percentage
FROM 
    customers
GROUP BY 
    segment
gold: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(has(c.tags, 'high-value')) / count() * 100, 2) AS persen_high_value FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment
